description: Port pi-mono's startup banner. Compact mode: single line showing 'Claude Code' + version + model name. Expanded mode: shows keybinding hints (Esc to interrupt, Shift+Tab to switch modes, /help for commands). Toggle with a keybinding (pi-mono uses a dedicated key in ExpandableText). Respect a quietStartup config flag to suppress entirely. Render above the top DynamicBorder separator. Depends on opi-j50.2 (DynamicBorder) and opi-j50.4 (layout wiring).
title: Welcome banner with ExpandableText
